searches.reason: Explore replacing single-negative binary training with multi-negative ranking objectives that improve difficult candidate discrimination, especially in Electronics. Seek practical comparisons of sampled softmax, negative-sampling correction, and false-negative handling; assess gains through the pinned macro validation HR@10 rather than training margins.

searches.reason: Investigate an architecture that separates persistent preferences from current intent using learned temporal gates and multiple interest representations. Recent and repeated interactions could distinguish direct task or artist matches from weak historical associations; timestamps provide evidence without assuming observed ownership satisfaction or user traits.

searches.reason: Explore combining SASRec with a sparse retrieval branch built from training-only item transitions and title/description lexical similarity. This offers a feasible alternative inductive bias for specific content and accessory relationships without pretrained weights; investigate evidence-aware fusion that avoids treating lexical resemblance as proof of compatibility.
